title: UK Hosiery & Textile News: Best Reads from the Sector
description: A curated reading list from the UK hosiery, knitwear and sewing sector: UKFT, De Montfort University, Knitting Together, Story of Leicester, museums and shows.
h1: UK hosiery and textile sector: the best reads
intro: Hand-picked articles and resources from respected UK sources on hosiery, knitwear, textiles and sewing. Summaries are ours; follow the links for the full stories.
